department: Vagelos Institute's Biomedical Research Education (VIBRE) PhD Programs

deadline.value: Submit the complete application, including test scores, by December 1, 2026 (5:00 PM EST).
deadline.quote: We ask that we receive your completed application, including all test scores, no later than December 1st.

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required, but you may send scores up to five years old.
gre_general.quote: The GRE is not required for our programs. | However, applicants may choose to submit GRE scores (must be no more than five years old)

funding.value: All PhD students get full tuition and fees, health insurance and a stipend of at least $50,008 (2026-27).
funding.quote: All PhD students in the VIBRE PhD Pathways program will be given full support for tuition and university fees, student health services, and medical insurance | You will also receive a generous stipend (at least $50,008 for FY26-27) for your personal use.

entry_route.value: Not stated on the pages checked.

app_fee.value: The application fee is $110, paid by card.
app_fee.quote: The $110 application fee can be paid by credit card at the time of application.

fee_waiver.value: Waivers are only for US citizens or permanent residents at US colleges with financial need, and US military.
fee_waiver.quote: Our programs will waive the application fee for: (1) US citizens or permanent residents currently enrolled in a US college/university who demonstrate financial need.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: You choose a mentor after rotations and coursework.
supervisor.quote: Students can explore multiple fields through rotations and coursework before committing to a program/disciplinary track

also.quote: Our programs are designed to provide maximum flexibility in selecting a mentor and research area.

notes: Umbrella program with ten tracks (e.g. cancer biology, genetics, immunobiology, systems biology); one VIBRE application covers the PhD pathways.
name: Biomedical Life Sciences (BLS) PhD
